top_news.title: I\textsuperscript{2}RiMA: Spectral Riemannian Representation with Temporal Attention for Mental Stress Detection based on EEG Signals
top_news.dek: I2RiMA uses spectral Riemannian representation and temporal attention to improve cross-subject EEG stress detection.
top_news.brief: The I2RiMA model addresses the challenge of subject-dependent EEG patterns by combining Riemannian geometry with temporal attention. By focusing on neural oscillations rather than fragmented time slices, it improves the accuracy of stress detection across different users.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing EEG signal processing pipeline

top_news.title: llm-coding-agent 0.1a0
top_news.dek: Simon Willison released an early-stage coding agent built on his LLM library.
top_news.brief: The llm-coding-agent 0.1a0 is a new Python library designed to function as an agent framework. It leverages the existing LLM library to implement coding workflows, with initial development assisted by Claude-generated specs.
top_news.image_alt: Terminal interface showing coding agent output

top_news.title: Anthropic: More details on Fable 5’s cyber safeguards and our jailbreak framework
top_news.dek: Anthropic detailed Fable 5's cybersecurity safeguards and proposed a new jailbreak severity framework.
top_news.brief: Anthropic has released documentation on the safety classifiers used in Fable 5, outlining specific cybersecurity harms they are designed to block. Additionally, they introduced a draft framework for categorizing the severity of AI jailbreak attempts.
top_news.image_alt: Chart illustrating AI safety classification levels

top_news.title: The Safari MCP server for web developers
top_news.dek: WebKit introduced a Safari MCP server to enable LLM-based browser automation for developers.
top_news.brief: Available in Safari Technology Preview 247, the new MCP server allows AI agents to connect directly to Safari browser windows. This integration enables agents to observe how code renders in real-time, facilitating faster debugging and automated testing.
top_news.image_alt: Browser window connected to an AI agent interface

top_news.title: Mark Zuckerberg tells staff that AI agents haven’t progressed as quickly as he’d hoped
top_news.dek: Mark Zuckerberg reportedly told Meta staff that AI agent development is lagging behind internal expectations.
top_news.brief: During an internal meeting, Meta's CEO expressed that progress on AI agents has not met the company's anticipated timeline. The comments highlight the ongoing technical hurdles in scaling agentic capabilities within large-scale consumer products.
top_news.image_alt: Mark Zuckerberg speaking at a company meeting

primary.title: AI Search - Manage AI Search sync jobs with Wrangler CLI
primary.summary: When you connect a data source to your AI Search instance, AI Search runs sync jobs to keep your index up to date with your content. You can now manage those jobs directly from Wrangler. For example, you can trigger a sync job from your CI/CD or automated pipelines with the jobs create command so your index refreshes when you push a change: wrangler ai-search jobs create my-instance This creates an asynchronous sync job that checks for changes in your data source, and sends new, modified, or deleted files to be indexed. The following commands are available: CommandDescription wrangler ai-searc
